summary: Santa Maria is a smooth, medium-weight engine builder where you place tetromino-shaped buildings on your colony board and activate whole rows or columns with placed dice, chaining production in a satisfying cascade. It scales well solo to four players and rewards planning your colony's layout more than any direct fight with opponents.
praised: quick to teach relative to its depth
criticised: multiplayer solitaire feel with little direct interaction
can suffer analysis paralysis planning colony layout
some expansion content adds complexity creep

interaction.kind: mostly parallel play with light drafting competition
interaction.detail: Each player develops their own colony board independently; the only shared contention is drafting which dice/buildings to take before opponents do. There is no direct attack or negotiation between players.

scoring.why: Points accumulate from buildings, goods produced, and various colony bonuses at game end.
scoring.how_you_win: Chain building activations efficiently across your colony to generate the most victory points by the end of the round track.
